title: The Secret of Two Generations/Quotes
summary:
"Simon Judeau, I presume." (Dante Vale)

"So, you know the truth. You're quite the resourceful detective." (The Professor)

"Team of detectives, actually." (Dante Vale)

"You call that pain? You don't know anything about pain!"
- Shauna to Lok Lambert
